name: claude-sdlc-skills
description: AI-native SDLC skills for Claude Code and other coding agents: requirement intake & audit, technical design, AI test orchestration, adversarial review gate, in-flight decision review, release config audit, write-time guardrail enforcement, artifact sync to team platform.

plugins.name: claude-sdlc-skills
plugins.description: Eight battle-tested SDLC skills: sdlc-intent (PRD digest + seven-layer audit + A/B/C risk tiering), sdlc-design (technical design doc: alternatives, tiered interface contracts, shared-asset ownership, C/H decision table, slicing constraints handed to task frameworks), sdlc-test (cases/dev/static/exec/spec/report with human checkpoints), sdlc-gate (risk-tiered adversarial review gate: 4/2 fresh-context subagents or main-session self-check by risk tier, plus guard_dev dev-release guard), sdlc-doubt (adversarial re-check of non-trivial decisions), sdlc-config-review (release config key scanner for Apollo/Nacos), sdlc-guardrails (deterministic write-time red-line engine: PostToolUse hook + pre-commit + baseline scan), sdlc-sync (artifact sync bridge between local markdown and the team-facing platform: submit/push-artifacts/pull-answers/publish/push-cases).
